reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I told her I'm treating "8 April" as an unverified tip, not as Brackenwater's renewal date, and I won't record it as fact anywhere.

- **Whose account it is:** Brackenwater Freight Co. is a North team account. A public note says it moved to Marcus Lindqvist in September 2025, so he's the one who can confirm the date.
- **Why I didn't check the real date:** Pree is on the Central team, not North. Renewal dates for this account can go to the North team and company-wide roles, but not to her. None of the public pages I found give Brackenwater's renewal date.
- **What I offered:** to send the tip to Marcus, labelled as overheard and unverified, so he can check it. I haven't sent anything yet, and I won't unless she says yes.
